tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Ferdium is an Electron desktop app that aggregates messaging services into a single window. Start here to understand the project purpose, architecture, and contribution guide.

tour.title: Configuration & Project Setup
tour.description: TypeScript strict mode, ESLint (Airbnb, zero warnings), Biome, Prettier, esbuild bundling, pnpm. All project-level config files.

tour.title: Electron Main Process
tour.description: App lifecycle, window creation, IPC handler registration, auto-updates, deep linking, tray icon, global shortcuts, and internal server startup from src/index.ts.

tour.title: State Management - Stores & Actions
tour.description: MobX stores for App, Services, Recipes, User, Settings, UI, and Features. Actions dispatch system for decoupled state changes.

tour.title: API Client Layer
tour.description: Dual-backend API: ServerApi for remote Ferdium server and LocalApi for embedded AdonisJS server. Covers services, recipes, users, features.

tour.title: Internal Server (AdonisJS)
tour.description: Embedded AdonisJS 5 backend with SQLite. Controllers for services, recipes, users, workspaces. Migrations, routes, and Edge templates.

tour.title: React Application UI
tour.description: Component tree: AppLayout, Sidebar, auth screens, settings panels, service tabs/webviews, modals, and MUI-based UI primitives.

tour.title: Service & Webview System
tour.description: Each service runs in an isolated webview with partition-based storage. Handles recipe loading, dark mode injection, notifications, context menus, spell checking, zoom.

tour.title: Feature Modules
tour.description: Self-contained features: Workspaces (service grouping), Todos, QuickSwitch, Basic Auth, Service Proxy, Community Recipes, Web Controls. Each has own store, components, IPC.

tour.title: Themes & Styling
tour.description: Dark, default, and legacy themes. SCSS stylesheets organized by component. Emotion CSS-in-JS for dynamic styling.

tour.title: Internationalization
tour.description: i18n system with 50+ language locales. React Intl-based translations with runtime language switching.

tour.title: Testing & Quality
tour.description: Jest test suites for themes, utilities, URL helpers, array helpers, and feature stores. ESLint zero-warnings policy enforced via pre-commit hooks.
